skills.title: ISO 27001
skills.description: The leading international standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS). It defines best practices for protecting data, managing risks, and maintaining continual improvement in cybersecurity governance.

skills.title: TISAX (Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange)
skills.description: Standard for information security in the automotive industry. It provides a framework for assessing and improving the security of information and communication technology (ICT) systems.

skills.title: ISO 21434
skills.description: The road vehicle cybersecurity standard that sets out requirements for managing cybersecurity risks throughout the entire vehicle lifecycle—from concept to decommissioning.

skills.title: ISO/IEC 27701
skills.description: A privacy extension to ISO/IEC 27001, providing guidelines for establishing and maintaining a Privacy Information Management System (PIMS) to protect personal data and meet GDPR compliance.

skills.title: IEC 62443-4-1
skills.description: A standard defining secure product development lifecycle requirements for industrial automation and control systems (IACS). It ensures that cybersecurity is integrated into each phase of product design, development, testing, and maintenance.

portfolio.title: ISO

portfolio.title: Google Cybersecurity Certificate
portfolio.description: Completed the Google Cybersecurity Certificate program, gaining practical skills in threat detection, incident response, and security best practices. Proficient in using various cybersecurity tools and technologies to protect digital assets.

portfolio.title: Degree in Cybersecurity
